description: Use loan-specific named parameter values for all In Loans and Out Loans start and end balances.
status: Applied and verified in the original financial plan.
rationale: End balance equals principal carried forward plus interest carried forward. This matches the existing monthly balance calculation while removing its dependency on start balance, allowing start balance to spill the preceding month's end balances without feeding back into end balance.
scope: 18 existing rows across nine loans. No new sheets, named functions, named ranges, layout changes, input changes, or Apps Script source changes.
